basis: Cupix project-coordinate export; May scan-to-BIM transform (alignment-analysis/accepted-registration.json) used as a visualization candidate, exactly as for Sep 17. No survey validation; no correction applied.

consistencyCheck.method: Independent ICP consistency check of the companion Oct 18 Cupix export against the accepted May registration (alignment-analysis/accepted-registration.json), run in a separate session on 2026-10-19; its evidence file is not part of this package.
consistencyCheck.result: Oct 18 project frame within 0.15 degrees and 0.04 m of the May registration frame (as reported). Visual overlay check only in this package; no per-capture ICP correction applied.
consistencyCheck.scope: Internal consistency between Cupix exports only; no survey anchors. Not surveyed accuracy.
